why: RJ-X60, pending #5990 (the harness runs one app per job; RJ-X45 waits on the same): look.apply and look.save run in Photo's and Library's catalogs since AJ-photo and AJ-library (suiteui/adjust-everywhere), but a job's multi-app stages don't run yet, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. Opens street.png (64 x 48 sRGB: sky, a red and a blue front, a yellow awning, pavement and road) in Photo and in Library, applies the built-in High Contrast B&W look (bw-high-contrast) in each, saves Photo's result as a look named Mine, and exports a PNG from each. The trap: the two apps make black and white differently (one desaturates, one mixes the weights), or Mine is gone after a relaunch. The assertion: the two exports match within 1 level per channel, every pixel of each is grey (red, green and blue within 1 level), and look.list names Mine after a relaunch; the turn-on runs the stages in order, compares out/street-library.png against out/street-photo.png, and sets platforms to linux and macos.
